0022600234.text: The Brooklyn Nets (3-8, 13th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-4, 9th in the West, 4th in the Southwest) with Brooklyn on a one-game winning streak and 2-5 on the road, while Memphis has lost its last game and is 5-0 away from home. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (illness, averaging 12.9 points in 23.2 minutes per game) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), both day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Nets winning the last meeting 126-115 in Brooklyn on March 9, 2026.
